assumptions.statement: at least 40% of 10 interviewed AU bookkeepers running spreadsheet prepayment schedules will name an unmet need (reconciliation, multi-org pricing, AU focus) they say no existing app covers
at least 5% of 100 landing-page visitors from accountant-community channels will join the waitlist
at least 3% of 40 waitlisted practices will pay a 19 USD pre-order deposit

at least 40% of 10 interviewed AU practices will name an unmet need that neither a low-cost incumbent add-on module nor a discovered direct competitor twin in the same app-store ecosystem (same name, same product, private beta, further along) already covers
